headline: AUM beat UAH and no unbeaten side remains
dek: UAH's first defeat of the season came at AUM on Saturday, and it leaves the conference without an unbeaten programme. AUM have now won eight of nine matches, their one defeat coming at North Georgia before conference play opened, and have conceded six goals along the way.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not meant points: West Alabama have scored 27 and conceded seventeen, and have won three of ten matches.

wire.line: Nobody is unbeaten now: UAH fell at AUM, who have won eight of their nine matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result, and all three are Christian Brothers', the earliest at home to McKendree.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UAH have conceded five goals in nine matches, and their win at Carson-Newman was their seventh of the season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Trevecca have scored 24 goals in ten matches and have lost only once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Spring Hill have scored two goals in six matches and have yet to win one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded twelve goals for Trevecca and kept four clean sheets.

last_match.line: Only AUM have beaten UAH this season; Trevecca are the only side to have taken a draw from them.

next_match.line: West Alabama have scored more than any side in the conference and have still lost half their matches; Christian Brothers have won once since conference play opened.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
